text:
marta: quick q — we have a security-only backport for 2.3.5. do we: bump patch on main, create a pinned 2.3.x release, or tag a hotfix branch and let deploybot handle it?

sam: my vote is patch bump + release note, unless the backport changes public API.

raj: agree. also need to decide whether deploybot should auto-pin stable channel or create an explicit pinned rollback tag.

emily: what does "auto-pin" mean here? last time it pinned and caused downstream infra to pull older deps. :grimacing:

nina: we had a followup hook that updated locks; that was the problem. For security patch I'd rather a pinned release with clear note: "do not auto-rollforward".

ops-bot: deploy-check: patch-only backport detected. impacted-components: auth, token-service. safe-to-auto-deploy? NO — requires manual verification.

marta: ok so manual deploy. semver question: do we tag 2.3.5 or 2.3.4-security. Which is our convention for backports?

sam: our semver policy previously: patch-only => increment patch. we should avoid ad-hoc suffixes unless it's a hotfix channel.

raj: +1. but add a metadata tag to the release notes and changelog entry: "security-backport" so UIs and deploy scripts can detect it.

emily: can deploybot read release metadata? if so we can have it require a human ack for security-backport tags.

deploy-bot: I can enforce manual_ack if release.notes contains "security-backport". To opt-in add: 
```
release: 2.3.5
meta: [security-backport, manual_ack]
```

nina: perfect. also add an ops checklist snippet in the release body: steps to verify tokens + smoke endpoints. keeps rollbacks straightforward.

marta: agreed. what about changelog granularity — do we redact internal bug IDs or include full CVE?

sam: include CVE if public. redact internal tracking IDs. end users need CVE.

raj: and add a small automated note in release-notes generator: 
```
if meta contains security-backport: append "Security: CVE-XXXX-YYYY; manual deploy required"
```

emily: one more: pin policy for customers using stable channel — should we pin them to 2.3.5 automatically?

nina: no auto-pin. notify account teams and recommend manual upgrade. Auto-pin risks unexpected behavior.

marta: summary: tag 2.3.5 (patch bump), add meta [security-backport, manual_ack], deploybot will block auto-deploy until human ack, release notes include CVE and ops checklist, DO NOT auto-pin stable customers. I'll open release PR with that template.

sam: thanks — can you add a short-line in changelog format we use: "2.3.5 — Security: CVE-XXXX-YYYY (auth token validation) — manual deploy"

marta: yep will do. creating PR now. pinging @release-channel once PR is up. :rocket:

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: post-deploy check at +30m and +24h.

raj: leaving a comment in PR to remind on lockfile updates — don't update global lock unless necessary.

emily: thanks all. low noise but high signal.

marta: closing thread once PR merged.
